name: speak-human-en
description: Write, edit, or adapt reader-facing English prose so it sounds natural and specific to its author. Use for English articles, Medium essays, newsletters, marketing copy, or translations that feel formulaic, inflated, or translated word for word. Preserve facts, evidence, uncertainty, and the author's point of view while improving English structure, rhythm, and reader context. Applies to English deliverables, not Chinese conversation, code, exact quotations, or legal wording
